Let me tell you what is happening out in Phoenix, and it’s an absolute disgrace to our country and our communities. On Wednesday night, local leadership completely bowed to progressive pressure and lawless agendas by approving a plan that places new restrictions on ICE and other law enforcement agencies using city property, as Danielle Miller reported on FOX 10. 

This is what happens when municipal leaders abandon traditional civic duty and cave to agitators who demand open borders at the expense of public safety and social order. Instead of backing the rule of law and supporting the brave men and women who keep our streets safe, these politicians are actively tying the hands of federal authorities. They are thumbing their noses at national sovereignty and personal responsibility, sending a dangerous signal that local resources are being weaponized against the very framework of law and order that holds our communities together. We cannot allow this assault on our safety and our borders to stand.
